instruction: The work is carried out with the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools. Update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Before starting the work, Bonsai is installed as a Blender extension, so start `/opt/blender/blender` and use the Bonsai tools from that environment. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a coordinated house-and-garage package where two simple building parts have been merged into one IFC4 file. The project team needs the house and garage separated cleanly for downstream quantity and procurement workflows without changing the combined massing. Preserve the house rooms, garage bay, ten envelope walls, three slabs, and connector apron. Use shared envelope and slab types, classify every space, wall, and slab by the building part it belongs to, group the house package separately from the garage package, and record the coordinated merge with revision code BONSAI-CLI-20.
